'''Landing Platform DDF453-17''' was a landing platform located in the upper levels of a [[Unidentified Coruscant hotel|hotel]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], several [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] attempted to capture [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] in the hotel. They were able to escape on board the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] from Landing Platform DDF453-17. They were pursued on to the platform, which had caught fire during the fighting, by stormtroopers who called for backup from arriving [[Coruscant Underworld Police|Underworld Police officers]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]].
